model_annotation: The chart illustrates the effect of different language families across various models, including mBERT and XLM, with different training configurations denoted by L2, R2, and B2. The horizontal axis lists the language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, while the vertical axis represents the effect, labeled but without units, ranging from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5, starting from 0 and ending at 30. Each language family is represented by a group of six bars corresponding to the models mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red), with error bars indicating variability or uncertainty. The bar heights vary significantly across language families and models; for example, IE-Indic has notably high values for mBERT-R2 (around 18), XLM-R2 (around 18), mBERT-B2 (around 25), and XLM-B2 (around 22), whereas Isolate and Uralic generally have low values across all models, typically below 2. The bars within each group are not stacked but rather placed side by side, allowing for direct comparison among the different models for each language family. The bars are not sorted by height or length, and there is no apparent visual emphasis on specific bars beyond the color coding provided by the legend.
